summary: OpenAI 在获得美国政府批准后，正式公开发布 GPT-5.6 模型，CEO Sam Altman 称其为“有史以来最好的模型”。同时推出“ChatGPT Work”智能体，结合 ChatGPT 与 Codex 能力，让非技术用户也能执行复杂任务。这标志着 OpenAI 在模型能力和产品形态上的双重突破。

title: Anthropic found a hidden space where Claude puzzles over concepts
raw_excerpt: The AI firm Anthropic has developed a technique that has given it the clearest glimpse yet at what’s really going on inside large language models as they answer questions or carry out tasks. What they found ranges from the mundane to the unnerving. Researchers at the company built a tool called the Jacobian lens (or J-lens) and used it to uncover a hidden area, which they named the J-space, inside Claude Opus 4.6, a version of Anthropic’s flagship LLM released in February. The J-space contains individual words that are related to the words and phrases that the model is most likely to spit out in a response in the near future. If Claude were a person (which it is not), you might say that these hidden words can reveal what’s on its mind before it actually speaks. Anthropic found that what an LLM is actually doing can often be different from what it says it is doing. The company claims that monitoring words that pop up in the J-space gives it a new way to understand and control its models. The company shared its results in a paper posted on its website this week. It has also teamed up with Neuronpedia, an open-source platform that lets you poke around inside LLMs yourself, to make a hands-on demo that anyone can try. “It’s very good and interesting work,” says Tom McGrath, chief scientist and cofounder at Goodfire, a startup that also builds tools to understand and control LLMs . summary: Anthropic 开发了一种名为 Jacobian lens（J-lens）的新技术，揭示了 Claude Opus 4.6 内部存在一个隐藏的“J-space”，其中包含模型在输出前“思考”的概念词。这是迄今为止对 LLM 内部推理过程最清晰的观察，对理解模型行为和安全性有重要意义。

summary: Meta 发布 Muse Spark 1.1 模型，号称在编码能力上实现“阶跃式”提升，支持复杂 bug 检测与修复、端到端智能体工作流以及多模态感知。同时推出 Meta Model API，向开发者开放模型能力，意图在 AI 编码领域与 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 竞争。

title: Meta launches Muse Image across its apps
raw_excerpt: Muse Image is an image-generation model that can create and edit images. It is now available in the Meta AI app, Instagram Stories, and WhatsApp. The model can perform multi-reference composition, room redesigns, prompt-based image creation and editing, and more. It can draw from public Instagram photos when a user tags an account. There will be an invisible watermark in the images it generates.
summary: Meta 正式推出 Muse Image 图像生成模型，可在 Meta AI 应用、Instagram Stories 和 WhatsApp 中使用。该模型支持多参考合成、室内设计、提示词生成与编辑，并能引用公开 Instagram 照片。所有生成图像将包含隐形水印，体现了 Meta 在创意工具领域的 AI 布局。

title: ByteDance debuts Seedream 5.0 Pro with advanced reasoning
raw_excerpt: Seedream 5.0 Pro is a multimodal image-creation model that offers precise edits, multilingual support, and advanced production-design features. It is designed for production design work rather than one-shot image output. The model is targeted at creators, designers, marketers, educators, product teams, and developers. It supports more than 10 languages, as well as some right-to-left layouts and accents.
summary: 字节跳动发布 Seedream 5.0 Pro 多模态图像生成模型，具备精确编辑、多语言支持和高级生产设计功能。该模型面向创作者、设计师和开发者，支持超过 10 种语言及从右到左的排版，标志着 AI 图像生成从“一次性输出”向“专业设计工具”的演进。

title: An off switch for dual use knowledge in AI models
raw_excerpt: GRAM (Gradient-Routed Auxiliary Modules) enables the benefits of training many separately-filtered models at the cost of training only one model. It gives models dedicated, removable compartments for each category of dual-use knowledge and only updates those compartments when learning from dual-use data. It allows parts of the model's knowledge to be deleted after training, providing a stronger framework for model safety.
summary: Anthropic 提出 GRAM（梯度路由辅助模块）方法，使模型在训练时仅为双用途知识创建专用且可移除的模块，训练后能精准删除特定知识。这为 AI 安全提供了更强的框架，允许在保持模型性能的同时移除危险能力，是 AI 对齐研究的重要进展。

title: SWE-1.7: Frontier Intelligence at a Fraction of the Cost
raw_excerpt: SWE-1.7 reaches frontier-level intelligence at a much lower cost. It is the result of broad improvements across Cognition's RL pipeline, including better infrastructure, more stable training, higher-quality data, and new techniques for long-horizon tasks. The model is available now in Devin on the web, desktop, and CLI. This post contains details on the infrastructure, algorithms, and data work behind the model.
summary: Cognition 发布 SWE-1.7 模型，以极低成本达到前沿智能水平。该模型通过强化学习管线在基础设施、训练稳定性、数据质量和长程任务技术上的全面改进实现，现已集成到 Devin 中。这展示了高效能 AI 编码助手的新方向。

title: Google will now tell you if an ad was made with AI
raw_excerpt: You can see if ads on Google Search, Google Discover, and YouTube were made or edited using AI from a new section in Google's "My Ad Center," as reported earlier by TechCrunch . The update, announced on Thursday, adds a "created or edited with AI" label under the "how this ad was made" tab. Users can find it by tapping the three dots or info button on ads, which pulls up the same panel where you can also block or report ads. Google says it will automatically apply the AI label to any ads made with its own generative AI advertising tools, but AI ads made elsewhere will need to have the label applied manually. summary: Google 在“我的广告中心”新增“使用 AI 制作或编辑”标签，用户可在 Google 搜索、Discover 和 YouTube 广告中查看 AI 参与程度。Google 将自动为使用其生成式 AI 工具制作的广告打标，其他平台制作的 AI 广告需自行标注。此举提升了广告透明度。

title: The ChatGPT browser is already dead
raw_excerpt: OpenAI is already shutting down ChatGPT Atlas, its browser that could do tasks for you on your behalf, less than a year after launching it. Atlas was announced in October , but as part of its wave of news about ChatGPT Work today , the company confirmed that it will be "sunsetting" Atlas and is targeting an August 9th date for deprecation. The shutdown follows OpenAI's push to reduce "side quests" and catch up with Anthropic on productivity features . summary: OpenAI 宣布关闭其浏览器产品 ChatGPT Atlas，距离发布不到一年。Atlas 原可代表用户执行网页任务，但 OpenAI 为聚焦核心产品并追赶 Anthropic 的生产力功能，决定将其整合到桌面应用中。这反映了 AI 浏览器赛道的激烈竞争与战略调整。
